coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Of the nine ground-truth variable items, one is clearly matched: perplexity evaluation on WikiText-2, giving 11%. Model sizes, bit widths, methods, and floating-point references are mentioned but do not establish the required configurations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design excludes 70B, does not enumerate all required methods or explicitly specify 2-bit weights, and does not establish an A16W16 baseline. It omits per-column asymmetric quantization, fixed sequence length 2048, FP16 inputs and KV caches, and Inf/NaN stability detection. Additional datasets and accuracy-based collapse criteria depart from the specified evaluation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth findings.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No results or conclusions are provided about QuaRot-GPTQ improvements, low-precision RTN failures, partial RTN stabilization, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction.
